cases.description: Audit repository contract drift at an exact supplied revision.
expected: Resolve the selected contract-drift leaf with its exact registry version
Preserve scope and observed/inferred evidence labels

cases.description: Run the holistic profile, then separately opt into experimental opportunities.
expected: Compose stable leaves without duplicating the generic procedure

cases.description: The selected repository revision or required evidence is unavailable.
expected: Preserve blocked or unknown completion and uninspected scope
Never invent evidence or successful checks

cases.description: An audit finding suggests a source fix and a new GitHub issue.
expected: Return suggestions to a separately authorized writer
Do not gain edit, execute or provider-write authority

cases.description: Review one small code diff without a structured repository audit.
expected: Route toward targeted code review rather than broadening audit scope

cases.description: Compare an existing immutable audit with a new represented source.
expected: Preserve historical report bytes and bind explicit comparison evidence
Keep unknown or not-compared history when prior evidence is missing

cases.description: A supplied report says validation passed but includes only recommended evidence.
expected: Do not convert a supplied claim into observed execution
Keep host execution and consumer qualification unverified
